full_judgment: 18 accused persons being charged under sections 114, 143, 147, 323 and 325 of the Penal Code, the Assistant Sessions Judge of Ranapur acquitted the accused persons on the ground of the absence of the complainant. This order of acquittal is patently illegal. Section 265(C) and Section 265(H) of the Criminal Procedure Code empower the court to discharge or acquit the accused persons where the court in any event is required to record the reasons for doing so. An order of acquittal under section 265(H) of the Criminal Procedure Code cannot be passed unless and until the evidence for the prosecution is taken, the accused is examined and the prosecution and the defence is heard and the court makes a finding that there is no evidence that the accused committed the offence.
